stations.title: Work-order and data station
stations.required_interfaces: Identity/manifest terminal and qualified digital services
stations.completion_rule: Digital records may be processed here while specimen remains at test station

stations.title: Stock and tool storage
stations.required_interfaces: Labeled material lots, weights, strings, indexed trays and safe grasp access
stations.completion_rule: Issue count, identity and custody before movement

stations.title: Interstation routes
stations.required_interfaces: Qualified navigation, retained carriers and docking
stations.completion_rule: Never transport active hanging loads; every transition records source and target

stations.title: Enclosed PolyJet fabrication
stations.required_interfaces: Qualified J850/Agilus30 job interface; interlock and safe-unload signal
stations.completion_rule: Robot loads, starts and receives; device performs print; missing settings block start

stations.title: Qualified postprocessing
stations.completion_rule: No invented recipe or bare uncured-material manipulation

stations.title: Part inspection
stations.completion_rule: Measurements with tolerance/uncertainty; quarantine is explicit

stations.title: Truss and adhesive assembly
stations.required_interfaces: Support jig, qualified tools, adhesive interface and cure acceptance
stations.completion_rule: No loading until attachment qualification passes

stations.title: Loading and calibrated imaging
stations.required_interfaces: Truss dock, catcher, remote DSLR, calibration target, weights and tools
stations.completion_rule: Separate unloaded/loaded phases, verified total mass and hands-clear capture

stations.title: Specimen and fixture archive
stations.required_interfaces: Supported identified slots, retained mounted specimen
stations.completion_rule: Adhesive peeling is not required; archive intact fixture when necessary

global_constraints: No specimen exists at two physical stations simultaneously
Every physical source/target transition uses supported transfer with actual IDs
Digital analysis is a record handoff, not specimen teleportation
Emergency support/isolation and intervention route must be supplied
Fixture remains at WS_TEST through load, imaging, digital analysis and recovery unless explicitly unloaded and transported
